integrity: Proof rests on signed cyclic Jacobian factors, the published itinerary correspondence, and a binomial roots-of-unity filter; finite enumeration is not an infinite proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the specific piecewise-affine twisted baker map, its nontrivial iterate-fixed points and the one-sided branch Jacobians. It does not determine primitive orbit counts, Lyapunov spectra, or perturbation stability. Exact periodic-word coding is attributed to the originating paper; a finite symbolic checker is diagnostic only.
title: Exact real-spectrum residue law for the twisted baker map
